timeline.home.description: The name of the home timeline (the posts of the accounts the reader follows), for assistive technology.

timeline.new_posts.description: The button over the home timeline's top while new posts wait or went in above the reader; pressing it shows them at the top. count is how many.

timeline.new_posts_missed.description: The button over the home timeline's top when posts may have been missed (after a reconnection); pressing it reads the newest posts again and shows them at the top.
